We are looking for a Project Controls Manager to work in a team delivering project management and construction management in an international environment. You will be based in the Amsterdam region and will be working for a major construction logistics project in Amsterdam area. 
( 5 april 2019 , Erik Schüssel ) 
Together with a company that designs, builds, finances and operates infrastructure assets for governments, businesses and organizations in more than 150 countries, we are looking for a Project Controls Manager. 
We are looking for a Project Controls Manager to work in a team delivering project management and construction management in an international environment.

The main task of the project controls manager is to ensure that the project is running within the confines of the main contract and budget limitations, including progress reports to Project Director. 
In this position you will report to the project director and will act as deputy during absence. Your main tasks are the following: 
• Providing project control services for the project, particularly financial planning, reporting and compliance 
• Monitoring and providing support in updating the programme and ensuring that the Project Director, Client and Contractor(s) are aware of necessary key critical actions/decisions in a timely way 
• Participating and supporting contract meetings and reporting on monthly basis to the client 
In order to qualify for this interesting role we are looking for somebody that has project and contract management experience, speaks fluent English and Dutch and has proven financial and cost reporting experience.A background in construction projects is a nice to have.

• Last step towards a Project Manager role

jobs.description:
About Us

We are here – always for you: Our company motto stands not only for satisfied customers but also for happy employees. For over 35 years, we have been an internationally oriented, independent logistics service provider with a future-oriented approach. We offer jobs for approximately 400 employees at 19 locations in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Mexico, the USA, Vietnam, and China. Additionally, we are connected to 156 exclusive logistics partners at all key locations worldwide.

As experienced order processors and project logisticians, our colleagues have made the TCI Group a powerful and progressive company in the international freight forwarding industry. Every day, they work to ensure that our company continues to grow together with them.

To strengthen our team in Rotterdam, we are looking for
Freight Forwarding Clerks (m/f/d) – Sea Freight Export and Import (LCL / FCL)
in a full-time, permanent position with flexible working hours, starting as soon as possible.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Independent order processing in the area of sea freight export and sea freight import
- Autonomous customer support and development in collaboration with supervisors
- Correspondence with our international customers and logistics partners via phone and email
- Scheduling, customs clearance, documentation and invoicing

Your profile

- Experience as a Freight Forwarding Clerk in the field of freight forwarding, logistics and sea freight
- Knowledge of customs regulations and customs clearance is desirable
- Proficient in industry-standard software and MS Office
- Good Dutch and English skills, both written and spoken

What we offer you

- A secure job with a permanent employment contract
- Good work-life balance through flexible working hours
- Option to work remotely from home
- International work environment and modern equipment
- Internal training and support for external training programs in freight forwarding (import/export)
- Events and benefit programs for employees

Do you recognize yourself in this profile?

We are looking forward to receiving your application in English along with a letter of motivation, CV and references.

If you have any questions please visit our website: https://www.mytcigroup.com

Or give us a call: +49 4041364498

You can find us at this address: TCI International Logistics B. V., Hoefsmidstraat 41, Unit E1.12, 3194 Hoogvliet, Rotterdam

Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Supply Chain Planner (m/f/d).

Responsibilities

As a Supply Chain Planner, you are responsible for optimally planning and coordinating materials, production, and inventory. (You ensure that customer orders are delivered on time and in full.) You ensure that products are available on time and that the Supply Chain operates efficiently and reliably.

- Ensuring optimal production planning
- Coordinating demand forecasts and translating them into concrete planning requirements
- Monitoring and managing inventory levels to achieve optimal stock and service performance, in collaboration with inventory management and procurement
- Identifying and resolving supply risks, shortages, and disruptions
- Collaborating closely with Procurement, Inventory Management, Warehouse, Production, Logistics, and Sales to align planning and execution
- Providing Supply Chain KPIs
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives within planning and broader Supply Chain processes.

What We Expect

- Good communication skills and the ability to effectively manage various stakeholders
- Strong planning, organizational, and coordination skills
- Strong Excel and data analysis skills
- Analytical ability and strong attention to detail
- The ability to work in a deadline-driven environment
- Proactive, solution-oriented, and flexible work attitude
- Experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP is an advantage
- Strong Excel and data analysis skills
- Fluency in Dutch and English

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

We offer:

- A responsible and versatile role within Supply Chain & Logistics
- A professional work environment with room for initiative and improvement
- Opportunities to contribute to process improvements within planning and Supply Chain
- A full-time position during regular daytime hours
- A role where you collaborate with various departments within the organization

Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d).

What your job includes

- Managing the logistical chain within the organization
- Developing employees of the supply chain team
- Professionalizing, designing, setting up, and improving Supply Chain workflows
- Strong interaction with various sales departments
- Determining the ultimate inventory turnover in collaboration with purchasing and inventory managers
- Providing the right input to Production to ensure optimal production capacity
- Providing realistic and reliable delivery times to customers via the Sales department
- Ensuring timely and accurate reporting of logistical KPIs
- Partly conducting purchasing negotiations with suppliers
- Initiating process improvements aimed at higher efficiency, lower complexity, shorter lead times, and lower costs
- Handling and following up on customer complaints related to the Supply Chain
- Monitoring and ensuring progress within the Supply Chain through timely and structured coordination with Production
- Enforcing and complying with company and safety regulations and ensuring proper application of HACCP, BRC, and ARBO guidelines
- Participating in cross-departmental projects
- Being a member of the management team

What We Expect

- Analytical and organizationally strengh
- Result-oriented and proactive mindset
- Good communication skills in Dutch & English
- Strong in organizing and improving processes
- Capable of connecting different departments
- Capable of developing and motivating employees
- Good negotiation skills with a problem-solving ability
- Focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement

Education & Experience

- Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working
- Experience within Supply Chain
- Experience in managing and developing employees
- Experience with supplier management and purchasing negotiations
- Knowledge of HACCP, BRC, ARBO, and relevant company regulations

What We Offer You

We are a company with flat hierarchies, strong values, and a clear focus on our customers. We know that our employees are the key to our success. That is why we quickly give you responsibility and help you grow according to your talents.

We offer:

- A responsible and versatile role within Supply Chain
- A professional working environment with room for initiative and improvement
- Opportunities to further develop processes and the organization
- A role where you are part of the management team
- A safe and future-oriented workplace

Our plant Henri van de Bilt in Beuningen is looking for a Production Manager (m/f/d).

Responsibilities

As a Production Manager, you are directly responsible for the production process and ensure efficient and high-quality production across various departments. You are responsible for output, productivity, and efficiency and directly manage the Shift Leaders.

Other tasks:

- Ensuring that all products are produced correctly, cost-effectively, and on time according to specifications and quality requirements
- Being responsible for achieving the set KPIs and SLAs, with an emphasis on productivity and quality
- Evaluating production processes and initiating and implementing improvement projects
- Ensuring the preparation and documentation of production processes, production flows, and training documents
- Responsibility for the production employees of the various departments
- Striving daily to deliver high quality to customers
- Effectively managing a team of Shift Leaders
- Leading and motivating employees to achieve production objectives
- Preparing and developing reports and dashboards to analyze current performance, trends, and improvement opportunities
- Coaching, developing, supporting, and training the team in daily tasks
- Participating in production-related projects

What You Need

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager who excels in leadership, organization, and achieving results within a production environment. 

You have:

- Relevant experience in a production environment
- Proven experience in a leadership or management role within production
